prompt.role: A thread you were copied on by mistake
prompt.text: You are copied on a thread that is not yours. It has customer account numbers, and one reply is from an address outside the company.

choices.label: Delete it so it is not on you
choices.debrief: Deleting your copy does not pull it back from the outside address.
choices.report: The thread was deleted from your mailbox only.
choices.voice_line: You deleted the thread instead of reporting it.

fallout.text: The outside address still has the numbers. No one else knew.

choices.label: Report it on the channel the company posted
choices.debrief: The posted channel is how the right people see it the same hour.
choices.report: The misdirected thread was reported the same hour.
choices.voice_line: You reported it on the channel the company posted.

choices.label: Forward it to your manager and stop
choices.debrief: Your manager may be the right person, and the posted channel is the one that is watched.
choices.report: It went to one manager, not to the reporting channel.
choices.voice_line: You forwarded it to your manager and did not use the reporting channel.

fallout.text: The manager was out. The thread sat unread all weekend.

draft_note: Forwarding to a manager is the partial credit. The watched channel is the full one.
